title: Amazon's Rekognition Falsely Matched Members of Congress to Mugshots
summary: Rekognition's face comparison feature was shown by the ACLU to have misidentified members of congress, and particularly members of colors, as other people who have been arrested using a mugshot database built on publicly available arrest photos.
